description: Client-side script for the 'Social Media Post' doctype in ERPNext, handling validation, dashboard rendering, post actions, and UI interactions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates social media platform selection and scheduled time before saving.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Updates character count display and triggers tweet length validation.

methods.name: validate_tweet_length
methods.description: Ensures tweet text does not exceed 280 characters.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initial trigger to set up dashboard when form loads.

methods.name: make_dashboard
methods.description: Fetches post data and renders metrics graph if post is posted.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes UI elements, including post status indicators and delete button.

methods.name: add_post_btn
methods.description: Adds 'Post Now' button to trigger immediate posting.
